sections.title: Cold Boot Baseline
sections.note: Full power cycle first. Do not SSH in until the Jetson is fully up.
items: After boot: hciconfig lists hci0 — adapter auto-powered
rfkill list bluetooth shows NOT blocked
systemctl is-active bluetooth → active
bash tools/gamepad/check_bluetooth_host.sh — 8 PASS / 1 WARN (ERTM) / 0 FAIL
Run echo $? immediately after — output must be 0
Check #9 reports Adapter is powered without having run bluetoothctl power on or hciconfig hci0 up since boot — confirms AutoEnable=true took effect

sections.title: Firmware Verification
sections.note: Black-mata comms-contract test — does the OpenCM exchange the data the black-mata system needs with the Jetson (NOT the full Dynamixel protocol). STOP the agent/dashboard first so the serial port is free: sudo systemctl stop black-mata-dashboard
items: Build: x86 python build.py (black_mata target) — completes, no errors
Upload: x86 ./tools/remote_update/x86_flash_opencm_bin_via_ssh.sh — flashes, board resets
OpenCM LED blinks after flash (firmware running)

items.t: Heartbeat + data contract: python3 tools/dynamixel/dxl_binary_monitor.py --check 30 → RESULT: PASS
items.how: Read-only (torque OFF — no servo motion). Asserts the black-mata STATE contract that ackermann_ui/dashboard actually consume: every configured servo available; pos/speed/temp/voltage in range; mode matches config; and seq advances with no gaps over the window. Run with the agent stopped — two writers on the port corrupt the stream and flip servo modes.

items.t: seq heartbeat steady — 0 gaps over the check window
items.how: The --check report prints the gap count; it must be 0. seq is the request/response heartbeat between Jetson and OpenCM — a gap means a STATE reply was lost or rejected.

items: Servo map: python3 tools/dynamixel/dxl_identify.py — all 8 IDs discovered, match config roles
No ID conflicts; all servos respond with AX-12A model

items.t: Watchdog e-stop: python3 tools/dynamixel/firmware_estop_test.py → RESULT: PASS
items.how: Nudges ONE steering servo ~12° (proves the command path), cuts the CMD-frame stream so the firmware watchdog (500 ms) drops torque — the servo goes LIMP — then resumes and the servo recovers. Verifies the firmware safes the robot when the Jetson goes silent. Never spins a wheel; refuses drive servos.

items.t: Firmware reports e_stop correctly (after ESTOP_REPORTING_SPEC.md fix)
items.how: KNOWN GAP: the current firmware never sets the STATE e_stop byte to 1 (it is cleared before every frame is built), so the watchdog above is verified by servo behaviour, not the flag. Once firmware/dxl_commander/ESTOP_REPORTING_SPEC.md is implemented, e_stop must read 1 on the first frame after the silence window. Until then this row stays not-tested.

Steer slider to −30° — correct opposite geometry
Return to 0° — wheels return straight, no drift

Reload ackermann_ui — all values repopulate correctly
ackermann_config.json contains default_drive_mode field

sections.title: Dashboard Startup & Config
items: Dashboard loads — no JS console errors (check browser DevTools)
conn-badge shows "connected" (green)
cfg-info bar shows correct max steer and max output % from config
Config refreshes within 5 s after manually editing and saving JSON
Drive mode is WASD on first load (matches default_drive_mode in config)
MJPEG feed visible in camera panel (proxied via :8082)

items.t: Camera frame matches robot POV — object on the robot's right shows on the right; forward = top of frame
items.how: Place a recognisable object to the physical RIGHT of the robot. It must appear on the RIGHT in the dashboard image, and the robot's forward direction must point to the TOP of the frame. Mirrored (left/right swapped) or rotated = fix the rotation in the camera config.

items: Bird's-eye SVG shows all four wheel icons
All four wheel steer angles read ≈ 0.0° at rest
Manually push a front wheel — angle label updates in real time
Ackermann arc appears when steer angle > 0.5°; disappears at 0

items.t: All 8 servos show temperature labels (S:°C, D:°C) — near ambient at rest
items.how: The AX-12A torques off at its Highest-Limit-Temperature (control-table addr 12, default 70 °C) — that auto-shutdown is what you're protecting against. At rest every servo should read near room temperature, expect < ~40 °C. Anything already hot at rest is a fault. Confirm the limit against your firmware if you changed it.

items.t: Battery fill bar shows non-zero percentage; voltage within ± 0.2 V of multimeter
items.how: Read the dashboard voltage and compare to a multimeter on the battery terminals — they must agree within ± 0.2 V. Record the dashboard reading.

sections.title: WASD Keyboard Drive

items: Topbar hint: "Hold ⇧ + WASD to drive or L1 + sticks (gamepad)."
Drive mode toggle shows ⌨ WASD selected
W/A/S/D without Shift → NO movement (deadman not held)
Shift + W → robot moves forward; release Shift → stops
Shift + S → robot reverses; release → stops
Output gauge bar fills during drive; returns to 0 on release
Shift + A → steers left; bird's-eye arcs correct Ackermann geometry
Shift + D → steers right
Shift + W + A → forward-left arc; both gauges update simultaneously
While Shift held: pill shows KEYBOARD (blue)
Release Shift: pill shows IDLE (or GAMEPAD: NONE)

items.t: Network kill test: hold Shift+W → drop dashboard traffic → robot stops ≤ 300 ms
items.how: On the Jetson, while holding Shift+W: sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8082 -j DROP. The robot must stop within 300 ms (deadman times out when frames stop arriving). Undo with the same line but -D instead of -A.

items: Restore iptables rule → dashboard reconnects; robot controllable again

sections.title: E-Stop — All Six Paths
sections.note: Test each path independently. Re-arm fully between each test.

items.t: [Path 1 — Space/Esc] Driving → press Space → instant stop; button turns amber "↻ HOLD TO RESET"

items: [Path 1] Shift+W while latched → NO movement
[Path 1] Hold button 1 s → latch clears; button returns to red "■ E-STOP"

items.t: [Path 2 — Button click] Driving → click red E-STOP → instant stop

items: [Path 2] Hold button 1 s → re-arms

items.t: [Path 3 — Gamepad combo] L1+sticks driving → L1 + D-pad diagonal → instant stop (rising edge, not held)

items: [Path 3] Dashboard button turns amber confirming latch

items.t: [Path 4 — LS+RS re-arm] While latched: hold both stick clicks 1 s → latch clears

items: [Path 4] Partial hold (< 1 s) → latch stays; must complete full 1 s hold

items.t: [Path 5 — Serial kill] Driving → physically unplug OpenCM USB → all servos stop ≤ 500 ms (full hot-unplug/replug cycle re-tested in SEC 15)
[Path 6 — Camera loss IS NOT E-STOP] Unplug camera while driving → robot KEEPS DRIVING (full cycle re-tested in SEC 15)

sections.title: 5-Minute Drive Endurance
sections.note: Drive continuously, cycling through all input modes. Clear run area required.
items: [0:00–1:30] WASD — figure-of-eight path; Ackermann arcs on bird's-eye track geometry
[1:30–3:00] Touchpad — same path; drag off-pad mid-drive intentionally — no runaway

items.t: [3:00–4:00] Robot BT gamepad — full-throttle sprint and hard steer; STATE seq keeps advancing, no disconnects
items.how: The dashboard/agent owns the serial port during driving — do NOT start a serial monitor here (it would contend for the port). Verify from the running dashboard instead: the conn-badge stays green for the whole sprint, and curl http://localhost:8082/state shows seq advancing between polls. A stall or a disconnect event is the failure. (Hard seq-gap / CRC counts are not available in v1.)

items.t: [4:00–5:00] PC gamepad from laptop — command-to-motion latency under ~150 ms
items.how: Quick check: at the 100 ms control tick, motion should start / stop within 1–2 ticks of input, no perceptible lag. To measure: film the controller and a wheel together at 240 fps (~4 ms/frame) and count frames between input and motion — under ~36 frames = under 150 ms.

items: Battery gauge decreased visibly (voltage drop under load displayed correctly)

items.t: Drive servos shifted warmer under load — none approaching the 70 °C shutdown
items.how: Drive servos warm under load (expected). They must stay well below the AX-12A 70 °C auto-shutdown — flag if any exceeds ~60 °C. Record the hottest reading at the end of the run.

items: All 8 servo IDs present throughout — no disconnection events
No dashboard JS errors for the entire session (console clean)

sections.title: Fault Injection
items: [Dashboard crash] Robot idle → pkill -f server.py → robot stays stopped (no spurious motion)
[Dashboard crash] Restart dashboard → conn-badge returns green; all widgets repopulate

items.t: [Serial hot-unplug] Driving → unplug OpenCM USB → servos stop ≤ 500 ms (firmware watchdog fires)

items: [Serial hot-unplug] Replug → server reconnects; send_estop() fires before allowing drive
[Camera hot-unplug] Driving → unplug camera → robot KEEPS DRIVING (processes isolated)
[Camera hot-unplug] Feed blanks; replug → restores without action; drive throughout uninterrupted
[Browser close] Driving via Shift+W → close browser tab → robot stops ≤ 300 ms

items.t: [BT out of range] Driving via Robot BT → carry controller 5+ m behind a wall → link drops; robot stops

items: [BT out of range] Return in range → GamepadReader auto-reconnects within a few seconds

sections.title: Final State Verification
sections.note: Clean reboot with auto-start enabled. Verify the robot ships in a known-good state.
items: Dashboard reachable at :8082 without any SSH after reboot
Camera feed live without any SSH
check_bluetooth_host.sh still passes (commissioning survived all testing)
ackermann_config.json has correct calibration values (steer offsets intact)
default_drive_mode in config is "wasd" (shipping default)
No stale BT bonds from test pairings (run a fresh pair to confirm clean state)

items.t: At rest with services running, STATE seq advances and e_stop = 0
items.how: Auto-start holds the dashboard/agent on the serial port, and its keepalive sends neutral frames at 5 Hz, so seq advances even idle — no need to stop the service or run a serial monitor. Verify: curl http://localhost:8082/state twice a few seconds apart → seq has advanced and e_stop is 0. (Only if no service is running, fall back to python3 tools/dynamixel/dxl_binary_monitor.py --rate 10.)

items: All widget values within expected ranges: battery within ± 0.2 V of multimeter, all servos < ~40 °C at rest, all steer angles within ± 1° of 0°
